blocks.text: Computer Management → Devices & Desktop offers Bluetooth, Audio Control, Keyboard Layout, Brightness and Android Devices. Pair only devices you recognize. Select the intended output/input in Audio Control before adjusting levels.
PipeWire provides audio and WirePlumber manages routing/policy. The Waybar audio menu controls the default devices. Microphone mute is separate from speaker mute.

Use Thunar for ordinary removable media and the managed external-drive/ADB utilities for their supported actions. Close files before unmounting storage. Do not approve unknown USB debugging prompts or reformat a device just because it is not visible.
